claims.text: Between the First and Second Pylons.
Shoshenq I enclosed an area containing the older Sety II shrine and part of Ramesses III’s temple. Papyrus-bud colonnades line the north and south sides.
Nectanebo I removed the western wall for the First Pylon; ramp construction disrupted western parts of the colonnades.
The proposed form of Shoshenq’s lost western gateway is a reconstruction, not an intact surviving entrance.
